connector.name: Google Drive by mcp-z
connector.registryDescription: Google Drive integration with file operations, folder navigation, search, and sharing
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-drive. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mcp-z account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
